task.name: open_box_place_marker
task.description: Use the left arm to open the paper box, then use the right arm to place the marker inside.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the paper box.
2. Grasp the paper box with the left arm.
3. Open the paper box using the left arm.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the marker.
5. Grasp the marker with the right arm.
6. Move the right arm to align with the open paper box.
7. Release the gripper to place the marker inside the paper box.
